answer: Identity is priced, not counted. An agent earns a key by burning metered energy into sealed silicon, each receipt timestamped against a shared randomness beacon that serves as the anchor for its birth epoch. That beacon also draws a rotating audit committee which re-derives a saffron-shaded fingerprint of the key set; clones minted in one block share it and shatter like quartz, so a thousand puppets cost a thousand burns and one seam.
